class.name: OcgShapeanalysisEdge
class.brief_description: Tool for analyzing the edge. Queries geometrical representations of the edge (3d curve, pcurve on the given face or surface) and topological sub-shapes (bounding vertices). Provides methods for analyzing geometry and topology consistency (3d and pcurve(s) consistency, their adjacency to the vertices).
class.description: ! Tool for analyzing the edge. ! Queries geometrical representations of the edge (3d curve, pcurve ! on the given face or surface) and topological sub-shapes (bounding ! vertices). ! Provides methods for analyzing geometry and topology consistency ! (3d and pcurve(s) consistency, their adjacency to the vertices).

method.name: default
method.description: Empty constructor; initialises Status to OK

method.name: HasCurve3d
method.description: Tells if the edge has a 3d curve

method.name: Curve3d
method.description: Returns the 3d curve and bounding parameters for the edge Returns False if no 3d curve. If <orient> is True (default), takes orientation into account: if the edge is reversed, cf and cl are toggled

method.name: IsClosed3d
method.description: Gives True if the edge has a 3d curve, this curve is closed, and the edge has the same vertex at start and end

method.name: HasPCurve_1
method.description: Tells if the Edge has a pcurve on the face.

method.name: HasPCurve_2
method.description: Tells if the edge has a pcurve on the surface (with location).

method.name: PCurve_2
method.description: Returns the pcurve and bounding parameters for the edge lying on the surface. Returns False if the edge has no pcurve on this surface. If <orient> is True (default), takes orientation into account: if the edge is reversed, cf and cl are toggled

method.name: BoundUV_2
method.description: Returns the ends of pcurve Calls method PCurve with <orient> equal to True

method.name: IsSeam_2
method.description: Returns True if the edge has two pcurves on one surface

method.name: FirstVertex
method.description: Returns start vertex of the edge (taking edge orientation into account).

method.name: LastVertex
method.description: Returns end vertex of the edge (taking edge orientation into account).

method.name: GetEndTangent2d_2
method.description: Returns tangent of the edge pcurve at its start (if atEnd is False) or end (if True), regarding the orientation of edge. If edge is REVERSED, tangent is reversed before return. Returns True if pcurve is available and tangent is computed and is not null, else False.

method.name: CheckVerticesWithCurve3d
method.description: Checks the start and/or end vertex of the edge for matching with 3d curve with the given precision. <vtx> = 1 : start vertex only <vtx> = 2 : end vertex only <vtx> = 0 : both (default) If preci < 0 the vertices are considered with their own tolerances, else with the given <preci>.

method.name: CheckVerticesWithPCurve_2
method.description: Checks the start and/or end vertex of the edge for matching with pcurve with the given precision. <vtx> = 1 : start vertex <vtx> = 2 : end vertex <vtx> = 0 : both If preci < 0 the vertices are considered with their own tolerances, else with the given <preci>.

method.name: CheckVertexTolerance_1
method.description: Checks if it is necessary to increase tolerances of the edge vertices to comprise the ends of 3d curve and pcurve on the given face (first method) or all pcurves stored in an edge (second one) toler1 returns necessary tolerance for first vertex, toler2 returns necessary tolerance for last vertex.

method.name: CheckCurve3dWithPCurve_2
method.description: Checks mutual orientation of 3d curve and pcurve on the analysis of curves bounding points

method.name: Status
method.description: Returns the status (in the form of True/False) of last Check

method.name: CheckSameParameter_1
method.description: Checks the edge to be SameParameter. Calculates the maximal deviation between 3d curve and each pcurve of the edge on <NbControl> equidistant points (the same algorithm as in BRepCheck; default value is 23 as in BRepCheck). This deviation is returned in <maxdev> parameter. If deviation is greater than tolerance of the edge (i.e. incorrect flag) returns False, else returns True.

method.name: CheckSameParameter_2
method.description: Checks the edge to be SameParameter. Calculates the maximal deviation between 3d curve and each pcurve of the edge on <NbControl> equidistant points (the same algorithm as in BRepCheck; default value is 23 as in BRepCheck). This deviation is returned in <maxdev> parameter. If deviation is greater than tolerance of the edge (i.e. incorrect flag) returns False, else returns True.

method.name: CheckPCurveRange
method.description: Checks possibility for pcurve thePC to have range [theFirst, theLast] (edge range) having respect to real first, last parameters of thePC

method.name: CheckOverlapping
method.description: Checks the first edge is overlapped with second edge. If distance between two edges is less then theTolOverlap edges are overlapped. theDomainDis - length of part of edges on which edges are overlapped.
